claim_boundary: This is a prospectively registered two-network-seed replication of the frozen v2.3 candidate, not a new candidate search. It can establish replication across seeds 2102 and 2103 under participant-level uncertainty, but it cannot establish a network-population prevalence, full human-behavior reproduction, unique tensor-product coding, a biological memory system, or dual access to stable-omitted evidence.

registered_rules.competence_or_integrity_failure: The affected seed is non-interpretable. Repair execution under the unchanged contract; do not replace the seed, change a threshold, or use the other seed to infer replication.
registered_rules.heterogeneous_or_unresolved: If a link passes in one seed and fails in the other, label that link heterogeneous_or_unresolved; do not pool participants or soften its rule.
registered_rules.link_replication: A primary link replicates only if its complete within-seed rule passes independently in both seed 2102 and seed 2103.
registered_rules.replicated_mechanism: Only if all four links replicate and every competence and integrity gate passes may the frozen v2.3 local/global causal decomposition be called replicated across these two independent backbones.
registered_rules.valid_link_failure: Preserve every independently replicated positive link but do not promote v2.3 into the project main model or begin dual_evidence_access_v2.4. Diagnose which invariant failed before registering a new mechanism.

registered_rules.P_L_double_dissociation: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bounds for P-off/local-intact retained-minus-omitted exact probability and sampled learned-minus-nonlearned accuracy exceed zero; the participant-bootstrap upper bound for P-off remote absolute minus 0.25 times v1 remote absolute is below zero; and L-off reproduces the v1 global channel and passes all global competence gates.
registered_rules.address_and_self_specificity: Within each seed, both the participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus query-key-shuffle retained direct correctness and the lower bound for retained correct-signed self contribution exceed zero.
registered_rules.causal_direct_rescue: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
registered_rules.retained_exact_probability_rescue: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for mean retained p_dual-p_v1 exceeds zero.

registered_rules.H_greater_A_rescue: The paired retained-subject bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 H>A direct correctness exceeds zero, and the dual-intact H>A direct-correctness bootstrap upper bound is at least zero.
registered_rules.aggregate_local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
registered_rules.global_branch_preservation: Original-v1/local-off exactly reproduces v1, passes every qualification_v2 intervention and query-order rule, retains positive query-binding contrasts, and retains an expected-rank-minus-MAP bootstrap lower bound above zero.
registered_rules.global_off_remote_collapse: The participant-bootstrap upper bound for global-P-off/local-intact remote absolute influence minus 0.25 times original-v1 remote absolute influence is below zero.
registered_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Dual-intact remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original-v1.
registered_rules.learned_accuracy_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 learned accuracy exceeds zero.
registered_rules.local_direct_specificity: For the natural local branch, the participant-bootstrap lower bound of mean absolute direct influence minus three times mean absolute disjoint remote influence exceeds zero.
registered_rules.local_only_direct_memory: Under global-P-off/local-intact, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for learned accuracy exceeds 0.55, the upper bound for nonlearned accuracy is at most 0.60, and the paired lower bound for learned minus nonlearned accuracy exceeds 0.10.
registered_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Dual-intact nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and its paired participant-bootstrap lower bound relative to original-v1 is no smaller than -0.02.
registered_rules.query_address_specificity: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus local-query-key-shuffle retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
